sections.h2: Of 679 routes that started, 331 have closed, half of them before subsidy ended

chart.title: Half of the 331 closed routes shut before their subsidy ran out
chart.sub: Routes that started under UDAN, by status at July 2026.

sections.means: Half the closures came while routes were still fully subsidised, so they were not short of support time.
sections.todo: Track closures by route and month so the 165 early closures are not hidden inside one total.

sections.h2: Across the first three rounds, 52% of awarded routes never started

chart.title: Only 54 of 774 awarded routes were still flying after their subsidy
chart.sub: Routes in rounds 1 to 3, position to March 2023.
chart.source: CAG performance audit of RCS-UDAN, to March 2023.

sections.means: Only 7% of the routes awarded were still flying once their subsidy had ended.
sections.todo: Report awarded, started and surviving routes on the same basis in every round so later counts can be compared.

sections.h2: Modified UDAN extends full support by half a year, then tapers it

chart.title: Tapering buys 3.5 years of full support against 3, but year three drops to 75%
chart.sub: Years of full viability gap funding per route.

sections.means: The new terms give about 17% more full support over a route's life but cut year-three support from 100% to 75%.
sections.todo: Judge the five-year taper against the 165 routes that closed under full subsidy, since a longer taper does not help them.
